brief: A portable AI agent that reads any codebase and generates/updates comprehensive documentation — READMEs, API references, architecture decision records, developer onboarding guides, and knowledge base entries.

decisions.decision: Established dual-market pricing ($79/$149 USD and ₹1,999/₹3,999 INR) with sub-₹2,000 frictionless UPI checkout and cross-sell bundling with codebase-context-engine
decisions.evidence: PRICING-STRATEGY.md approved and synchronized across DEVELOPER-COMMERCIAL-PRICING.md and store listings

decisions.decision: Build AI Codebase Documentation Agent as highest-value product
decisions.evidence: Market research shows developers avoid writing docs, paid alternatives exist ($8-40/mo), and no one-time-purchase portable agent exists in the market

decisions.decision: Agent contract: buyer provides codebase path → agent generates README, API reference, ADRs, onboarding guide → human reviews before commit
decisions.evidence: Pricing matrix aligned with portfolio standards ($79-149 US, ₹1,999-3,999 India)

decisions.decision: Portable SKILL.md with 4-stage pipeline (discovery → analysis → generation → output) operating on local files only
decisions.evidence: 12 languages supported, 4 doc types, 5 refusal/escalation rules for safety

assumptions: Buyer has an existing codebase they want documented
Buyer uses a CLI/IDE that supports SKILL.md-based AI agents
Buyer is willing to provide read-only filesystem access to their codebase
Agent operates on local files — no cloud API dependencies beyond the LLM provider
Model: Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o / Gemini 2.5 Pro for code analysis

testResults.summary: All structural and functional checks pass. Runtime LLM-dependent behavior not tested in offline mode.
